Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
<X_Ze...@cox-internet.com> wrote in message
news:1102362523....@c13g2000cwb.googlegroups.com...

> Which card exchange was that? It must have been the one from WotC for
> my Madness of the Bard (Dark Sovereigns), The Return to Innocence
> (Ancient Hearts) , Cunctator Motion (V:TES) , High Stakes (V:TES), and
> Playing for Keeps (Dark Sovereigns). There have been cards banned
> since 1997.

Since 1995, actually.

The first banned list appeared in October 1, 1995 (effective a month
later) :

Cunctator Motion
High Stakes
Rowan Ring
Monocle of Clarity
Stake

(It was also accompanied by a restricted list -- a list of
cards that were restricted by a 2CL: Ancilla Empowerment,
Conservative Agitation, Domain Challenge, Earth Meld, Fifth
Tradition, Form of Mist, Freak Drive, Kine Resources
Contested, Majesty, Parity Shift, and Sabbat Threat; and it
banned mixing card backs in the crypt and banned the use of
sleeves unless all players at the table agreed to allow them.)

Playing for Keeps was added to the banned list in January 1996.

Madness of the Bard was added in July 1997, bringing the
total to 6.
(The restricted list disappeared some time before then).

In March of 1999, Stake was removed from the list and Return
to Innocence was added.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Denis GERARD wrote:

> Due to the rarity of the card (2 fixed unco, 1 rare), I think that players
> deserve a new card exchange program for these recently banned cards.

Dude. This is a collectible card game. Sometimes cards get banned. That is
just a fact of the format of the game. Compared to many games in the history
of the format, VTES is wildly successful at not banning that many cards. In
the history of this game, the follwong cards have been banned:

-A handfull of Ante cards. No longer printed. Still banned.
-Return to Innocence. No longer printed. Still banned.
-Madness of the Bard. No longer printed. Still banned.
-Monocle of Clarity. Currently printed. No longer banned.
-The recent three of the new ones.

I might be missing one or two. In 10 years of this game existing, there are,
what, less than 10 cards in cirulation that you can no longer use in
competetive play. There was no need to have an exchange program then. There
is no need to have an exchange program now.

Peter D Bakija
